metadata.description: Here's a collection of selected video game music tracks that will hopefully be heard in its second audio channel on the new all-video game channel from the CER Two Digital Networks suite called CER Two Arcade which will offer all video games, all the time, 24 hours a day with longplays, gameplays, game clips, arcade tours, video game news and information, and interviews with gamemakers.
